prompts.name: arrival
prompts.prompt: Edit this exact scene into a clearer one-bit adventure illustration that READS AT128x64 PIXELS. Preserve recognizable composition, camera/perspective, subject locations and depth from overlapping near/mid/distant forms. Simplify small detail into LARGE COHERENT clean black/white shapes, continuous silhouettes and broad lit planes. Selective coarse25percent ordered shade only on small curved-side patches, never all-overgrain or floorcheckerboards. No people, human silhouettes/hands, lettering/captions/UI/borders or extra subjects. All cargo INTERNAL, no deckboxes. The arriving submarine at left MUST be the visual hero: rounded cylindrical hull with a CONTINUOUS LIGHT WHITE SIDE spanning behind and around its THREE LARGE SOLID BLACK PORTHOLES. White upper hull and white side, only a narrow dark belly below the portholes. This is essential: do not bury the ports in a dark or dithered body. Clean compact conning tower, antenna, tail fins/propeller, all silhouette edges distinct. Remove rivets and most hullbands, keep only one narrow curved shade transition. Keep currentboat scale and placement. Simplify the dock/refuge at right into a few QUIETER and DARKER broad planes; its bright loadingbay should be small and secondary, not compete with hull. Retain cropped nearbollard/depth, but make its top mostlydark rather than giantwhite. Sparse waterlight accents, leave large pureblackwater. Clear fully recognizable approach to Benthos.

nativeRendering.method: Balanced v3 integer source-cell RGB mean, solid endpoints outside threshold +/-40,25/50/75%2x2 ordered middle tones; improved geometry is in the edited source artwork.

const fs=require('fs'),z=require('zlib');function crc(b){let c=0xffffffff;for(const n of b){c^=n;for(let j=0;j<8;j++)c=(c>>>1)^((c&1)?0xedb88320:0);}return (c^0xffffffff)>>>0;}function chunk(t,b){let n=Buffer.alloc(4),tail=Buffer.alloc(4);n.writeUInt32BE(b.length);const body=Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(t),b]);tail.writeUInt32BE(crc(body));return Buffer.concat([n,body,tail]);}
for(const name of ['arrival','grow-tanks','repair-bay']){const base='docs/assets/first-beat-clarity-v6/'+name,png=fs.readFileSync(base+'.png');let w,h,ch,bufs=[];for(let p=8;p<png.length;){let n=png.readUInt32BE(p),t=png.toString('ascii',p+4,p+8),b=png.subarray(p+8,p+8+n);if(t==='IHDR'){w=b.readUInt32BE(0);h=b.readUInt32BE(4);ch=b[9]===2?3:b[9]===6?4:0;if(b[8]!==8||!ch)throw Error('Unsupported PNG');}if(t==='IDAT')bufs.push(b);p+=n+12;}const raw=z.inflateSync(Buffer.concat(bufs)),pix=Buffer.alloc(w*h*ch),stride=w*ch;let p=0;for(let y=0;y<h;y++){let f=raw[p++];for(let x=0;x<stride;x++){let a=x>=ch?pix[y*stride+x-ch]:0,b=y?pix[(y-1)*stride+x]:0,c=y&&x>=ch?pix[(y-1)*stride+x-ch]:0,v=raw[p++];if(f===1)v+=a;if(f===2)v+=b;if(f===3)v+=Math.floor((a+b)/2);if(f===4){let q=a+b-c,pa=Math.abs(q-a),pb=Math.abs(q-b),pc=Math.abs(q-c);v+=pa<=pb&&pa<=pc?a:pb<=pc?b:c;}pix[y*stride+x]=v&255;}}const out=Buffer.alloc(129*64);let white=0,previousDither=0,balancedDither=0;for(let y=0;y<64;y++){out[y*129]=0;for(let x=0;x<128;x++){let sum=0,count=0;for(let yy=Math.floor(y*h/64);yy<Math.floor((y+1)*h/64);yy++)for(let xx=Math.floor(x*w/128);xx<Math.floor((x+1)*w/128);xx++){let i=(yy*w+xx)*ch;sum+=(pix[i]+pix[i+1]+pix[i+2])/3;count++;}const lum=sum/count;const threshold=name==='arrival'?96:127.5,lo=threshold-40,hi=threshold+40;if(lum>32&&lum<224)previousDither++;const middle=lum>lo&&lum<hi;if(middle)balancedDither++;const level=!middle?(lum>=threshold?4:0):lum<threshold-13?1:lum<threshold+13?2:3;const order=[[0,2],[3,1]];let v=level>order[y%2][x%2]?255:0;out[y*129+1+x]=v;white+=v===255;}}let hdr=Buffer.alloc(13);hdr.writeUInt32BE(128);hdr.writeUInt32BE(64,4);hdr[8]=8;hdr[9]=0;fs.writeFileSync(base+'-native.png',Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10]),chunk('IHDR',hdr),chunk('IDAT',z.deflateSync(out)),chunk('IEND',Buffer.alloc(0))]));console.log(JSON.stringify({name,width:128,height:64,white,black:8192-white,previousDither,balancedDither,reductionPercent:+(100*(1-balancedDither/previousDither)).toFixed(1)}));}
